label: Footwear
description: Named shoes, boots, sandals, slippers and traditional footwear, grouped by construction and use.
notes: One footwear type per value belongs here, including everyday shoes, formal shoes, traditional forms and recognizable dance shoes. Complete looks belong in the person.outfit lists; other clothing accessories belong in person.accessory and hats in clothing.headwear. Values use natural plural footwear names after wearing, without a specified color or brand. Named subtypes replace vague parent categories when their construction gives a more useful visual distinction, and traditional forms carry no descent tags.
